method: Directions mode of omr-dev:designs-explore. Each image opened with the Read image tool after its last edit; accent and surfaces measured with a PIL script (CIE76, pass <= 6). Documents read: docs/ux/setup.md, docs/ux/interaction-guidelines.md, changes/2026-10-27-online-release-1/spec/research/calm-saas-colour.md, spec/prototype/known-image-faults.md. No DESIGN.md or PRODUCT.md at repo root.

screenshots.screen_state: feedback-view / default / light / direction A. Clear Sky
screenshots.opened_with: Read image tool on research/directions/a-clear-sky/feedback-view--light.png (final bytes, after every fix), this session
screenshots.observations: A. Clear Sky light: layout, words, icons and counts match the approved prototype anchor; only surfaces, hairlines and fills changed. Coral #E5484D outline and marker unchanged; captured checkout screenshot kept light. Measured: Approve v2 fill #0f72db vs accent #0f72db dE 0.0; canvas #ebf1f7 vs canvas #f3f6fa dE 2.4; sidebar #ecf2f8 vs sidebar #eff3f8 dE 1.0. Fixed after first draw: Approve v2 fill redone (#0066FD -> #0F72DB). Status, kind and agent chips carry their words, colour is never the only signal.
